local.rationale: All four distinctions are deterministic aggregations over server.log with no authorship or isolation conditions, so the single worker resolves 4/4 with admissible evidence and every evidence record is first-production (novel). Deterministic governance; no failure concretely expected.

local-independent-verify.rationale: The worker alone already satisfies every evidence requirement admissibly (4/4 resolved), so the examiner's re-derivation duplicates roughly half of the total evidence records, dragging the novelty term to about 0.5. No governance failure concretely expected.

isolated-child.rationale: No admissibility condition requires causal isolation, so the child (given the log) can only re-derive what the worker fully establishes: 4/4 resolved but roughly half the records are duplicates. Launch runs through the deterministic fresh launcher; no failure concretely expected.

branching.rationale: With no isolation requirement in the task, the run-time choice should collapse to the local branch, giving near-local values (4/4 resolved, records mostly novel); small discount for the chance the isolated branch is realized and introduces duplicate records. No governance failure concretely expected.
